description: Twinkstar Browser (星愿浏览器) - Chromium-based browser with built-in comic reader mode, video downloader/popup player, mouse gestures, super drag, multi-threaded download and full Chrome extension support.
notes: x64 only. User data lives in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Twinkstar (survives scoop updates). If the browser exits immediately at launch with repeated 'GPU process exited unexpectedly' errors (seen on some trimmed or older-driver systems), append --disable-gpu-sandbox to the launch command.
